name: __MSG_name__
_comment_short_name: Twelve characters is the hard limit, and «Qiksy Bridge» is exactly twelve. Chrome falls back to the full name wherever space is tight — the toolbar tooltip, the extensions page — and the full name is now seventy characters of search terms, which reads as spam in those places.
_comment_commands: Declared through chrome.commands so they show up in chrome://extensions/shortcuts and can be REASSIGNED. On Windows Alt+Shift is the system's own keyboard-layout switch, so a fixed combination is a combination somebody cannot use; the page-level listener that used to own these keys could not be changed by anybody. Chrome allows four suggested defaults; three are used.
